positions.title: .NET Software Developer
positions.description:
Perform integration work with various software companies/partners and billers
Utilize the Invoice Cloud development tools to import and export various data file formats to/from the database
Manage and configure various communication methods including but not limited to: FTP, Stratus, Data Pump, Web Services, External API's based on various needs of the partners
Participate in design and strategy meetings centered around new integrations
Modify existing integrations to support new functionality
Provide technical support for integrations

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Performed and supported integration work with various software companies/partners and billers. Utilized and customized Invoice Cloud APIs and development tools to import and export various data file formats to and from Invoice Cloud databases. Updated and improved invoice templates, UI, and branding using HTML, CSS, VB.NET, ASP.NET Web Forms, and Adobe Photoshop. Managed and configured various communication methods, including but not limited to: FTP, Stratus, Data Pump, Web Services, and External APIs based on the various needs of the billers. Participated in design and strategy meetings centered around new integrations. Modified existing integrations to support new functionality. Maintained existing products by tracking down bugs and offering application support to other teams as needed.

positions.title: Agent
positions.description: Worked as a freelance consultant evaluating data. Conducted search engine analysis and evaluation based on client specifications. Evaluated content of all assigned websites and ensured its effectiveness. Tested and reviewed new technologies; such as voice prediction, context queries, and location integration. Evaluated queries and their results and assisted with improving algorithms used by search engines. Examined audio transcription and web video, and rated page quality in a timely manner.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Health Care Software Solutions
Created and maintained Database files, Transaction log files, DTS packages, SSIS packages, Views, Triggers and Stored Procedures
Managed jobs and monitored SQL Server Agent Error logs
Provided enhancements using SQL, T-SQL, DNN framework, VBScript, XML, XSLT, and JavaScript
Designed and tested workflows for iPad application, Patient KIOSK
Implemented software and provided support for clients at 75+ sites

projects.title: Inspirational Homepage
projects.description: 'Inspirational Homepage' is a React + Redux that displays the weather info for the users current location,  a random inspirational quote, let's the user cycle through soothing background images,  and contains a task list that the user can add to,  remove from, or mark as complete. it uses React, Redux Toolkit, Sass (SCSS), the OpenWeather API, the Unquotable API, the Unsplash API, Framer Motion for the animations,  Axios for the API calls,  and some other packages. You can find it running on my website at https://inspirational-homepage.danielnmyers.com
